one_sentence_story: A single source trace is quarantined in a transparent context capsule, selects one cusp through a torus family, and closes only as a conditional S6 paper claim when a matching world trace returns.

beats.title: Source emits one trace
beats.causal_move: The source artifact releases exactly one amber evidence particle.
beats.visual: A warm paper-like source slab stands on the left terrain plate; its only legible label is SOURCE. One amber point exits its lower edge.

beats.title: Stream crosses the capsule
beats.causal_move: The amber particle stretches into one luminous line and enters the capsule.
beats.visual: The line travels left to right along a shallow sine path into a transparent rectangular Context Capsule; the terrain grid stays dark and still.

beats.title: Context changes the carrier
beats.causal_move: The capsule releases the same line in cool blue, showing a context transition without adding a second source.
beats.visual: A small neutral diamond is suspended inside the capsule; after the line passes it, the outgoing segment turns blue. No dashboard panels or pseudo-text appear.

beats.title: One cusp is selected
beats.causal_move: The blue line enters a family of three torus rings and locks onto one hexagonal cusp fibre.
beats.visual: Three low-poly torus rings rotate by a fixed quarter turn; a thin hexagonal fibre spans their shared cusp. The blue stream touches one vertex and pauses.

beats.title: Receipt closes the loop
beats.causal_move: A returned world trace completes the blue path and changes the open question into a conditional paper claim.
beats.visual: A white receipt sheet rises on the right from a circular world-trace plate; one blue dot travels back to the cusp, and a restrained label resolves to S6 CLAIM - CONDITIONAL.
beats.object_state: source_artifact=persistent; capsule=persistent; torus_family=persistent; cusp_fibre=locked; world_trace=returned; claim=status_conditional

caption_script: Context changes the carrier, not the origin.
The family narrows to one cusp.
The paper's S6 claim is conditional on that receipt.

manim_plan.camera: fixed 3D orthographic camera; left-to-right dolly of 0.35 units only at beat 5

timing.transition: linear for evidence travel; smoothstep for object reveals; no stochastic motion

construction: Create all terrain plates, source, capsule, torus family, cusp fibre, receipt, and labels before animation.
Use fixed seeds only for subtle terrain displacement; set seed=33 and keep all object IDs stable.
Animate the single stream with a ValueTracker from source to capsule, then recolor the outgoing segment blue.
Rotate each torus exactly PI/2 with phase offsets [0, PI/6, -PI/6]; freeze the fibre at the selected vertex.
Render the final claim as text, never as texture or pseudo-text; keep the claim visibly conditional.
manim_plan.readability: Use only SOURCE, CONTEXT CAPSULE, S6 CLAIM?, and S6 CLAIM - CONDITIONAL; all labels are vector text.

falsifier.paper_claim_boundary: The S6 statement is a paper claim, not a consensus fact.
falsifier.test: Replay the same source and context against a recorded world trace; if the returned trace does not match the selected cusp or no receipt exists, the loop stays open.
falsifier.visual_failure_state: Remove the return dot, leave the torus cusp unlocked, and keep the label S6 CLAIM? instead of resolving it.

receipts.visual_reference_role: visual grammar only; not operational evidence
receipts.measurement_note: Local measurements and validation receipts are recorded in d-W1-EVIDENCE-THREAD-33.md.rapor.md.
